one_line: A concrete milestone as the reason for the book, then the baby's hands testing the pages.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down white mailer box with a "TinyBook" sticker, a hand on it; 0:01 the lid opens and the cover shows. Voice and purple subtitle together (transcript): "יש רגעים שפשוט חייבים לשמור לנצח".
q1_hook.why: Unboxing motion in the first second and a sentimental line, said and written together (E1, H6). But frame one is a closed box with a brand sticker, not the book (S1), the line names no buyer or product until about 0:05 (H2), and the frame is letterboxed from 0:03 (H7).

beats.what: Top-down box; the lid opens and the cover shows; "יש רגעים שפשוט חייבים לשמור לנצח"
beats.why: A reveal with a feeling attached

beats.what: Letterboxed: a hand lifts the cover and flips an animated-style nursery story; "לכבוד המעבר"
beats.why: States the occasion behind the book

beats.what: Page flips; "בזכות טכנולוגיית ה AI המתקדמת", "הדמות בסיפור נראית ממש כמוהו"
beats.why: The likeness claim, sold as technology

beats.what: Full frame: a baby's hands pull at the pages; "ידיים סקרניות ... לא יצליחו להרוס"
beats.why: A durability check no one can argue with

beats.what: Cover and pages of a second book with the family dog; "אפילו יצרתי לו ספר נוסף"
beats.why: Shows a second use and a new picture

beats.what: A baby's hand and head over the open book on a sofa; "זה בדיוק הזמן להתחיל להכניס ספרים"
POV in bed: a man's hand and knee, cover toward the camera; "אין דרך מרגשת יותר מלהפוך אותו"
beats.why: A bedtime image closes the story

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption ends on a 10% code; it asks for no comment, share or save.
q2_flow.why: The baby's hands at 0:20 and the second book at 0:23 are fresh beats (R3), but the first 17 s are one flip-through under a spoken script, where it can sag (R1). The bedtime POV is a warm last image (R4, K1).

q3_cta.what: None in the video; it ends on "אין דרך מרגשת יותר מלהפוך אותו לסיפור" (0:42). Caption, last line: "יש לי בשבילכן קוד קופון של 10% הנחה: Roni10".
q3_cta.why: One ask, a code with a real discount (C1, C2), but only in the caption: the video ends on a feeling, not a pointer, so a viewer moved at 0:43 sees no next step (C6). The offer follows a long emotional text, not the caption's first line (C6).

q4_shown.what: The TinyBook box and cover, 3D-animated parents and baby, the child's name in the title; hand-flipped pages to 0:20; a baby's hands pulling a page; a second book with the family dog; a man's hand holding the cover in bed. No price.
q4_shown.why: The baby's hands on the pages are a believable use proof (S1). A parent's first-person occasion story vouches (S6). But no real photo sits beside the characters, so "נראית ממש כמוהו" is only said (S2). The personalising step is named as technology, never shown (S8). The baby's face never appears (S5).

q5_edit.what: 8 shots in 44.4 s, about 5.5 s each: long handheld takes, hard cuts. Black bars at top and bottom from 0:03 to 0:20. No speed changes seen. Purple subtitles, word by word, almost wall to wall. Ends on a static POV shot.
q5_edit.why: A change at 1 s, then one 17 s take with no cut, is a long hold (E1, R1). The black bars break the full-screen rule (F1). Subtitles follow the voice (E4). It ends on the last line with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother's story: her baby's move to his own room and bed becomes a personalised book, plus a second book with the family dog, with a code.
q6_topic.why: A milestone, the move to a big bed, gives a concrete buying moment (K7) and a real parent feeling, "הזמן טס" (K6), told tenderly rather than with a peak (K1). "זמן איכות, התפתחות" is a modest claim (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down shots of the box and pages on a cream sofa, a hand flipping; a baby's hands in close-up; a POV shot in bed of a man's hand and knee. Home daylight; no faces.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands flipping put the viewer in the reader's seat (F5), but the pages are tilted and the story text is unreadable (F4). The file is small and letterboxed in the middle (F1, F3). Only hands and a knee appear, so no child's face (S5).

q8_text.on_screen: Bold purple Hebrew with a dark outline, 1 to 3 lines, word by word, about 80 to 90% down, over the pages and a jeans knee: "יש רגעים שפשוט חייבים לשמור לנצח" (0:01), "היה לי חשוב להכין לו ספר אישי" (0:05), "בזכות טכנולוגיית ה AI המתקדמת" (0:12), "הספר צבעוני עם כריכה קשיחה" (0:17), "זה בדיוק הזמן להתחיל להכניס" (0:30), "אין דרך מרגשת יותר מלהפוך אותו לסיפור" (0:42).
q8_text.caption: Starts with the milestone and "זה הרגע שבו הבנתי שהתינוקי שלי כבר לא כל כך קטן..". Three short paragraphs, about 60 words: the milestone, a personal book to read before bed, then the 10% code "Roni10". No brand name, no hashtags, no disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Subtitles echo nearly the whole script, so it works muted (T1), but they run to 3 lines over pages and a knee, in the bottom 35% (T2, T4, F2). The caption has milestone and "ספר אישי" words but no hashtags or brand name (T7), and no disclosure word (T8).

weak_points: Letterboxed from 0:03 to 0:20; a 17 s flip-through with tilted pages; "AI" named on screen; the code only in the caption; no brand name in the caption; no disclosure word.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with the milestone line and the box, film a steady top-down flip-through, add a baby's hands on the pages, end on the offer on screen.
not_verified: Whether music plays; who the man is; the second book's price and page count. The baby's age, almost nine months, is from the transcript. The 480 x 854 size and black bars are of the downloaded copy and may differ from the posted file. The transcript has garbles, so burned-in text is quoted. The child's name is in the cover title, subtitles and caption, not quoted. The brand is TinyBook, a competitor, and the caption does not name it.
